concepts.name: 아이보리블라우스·네이비
concepts.design: 아이보리 V넥 반소매 블라우스·네이비 무릎길이 H라인 스커트
concepts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: one SMART, TASTEFULLY SKIN-REVEALING EVERYDAY OFFICE OUTFIT on the same fictional adult woman, age 28-32, in the edit target. Change clothing and footwear ONLY. Preserve exact platinum-white straight asymmetrical chin-length bob, wine-red eyes, mature facial shape, brows, nose, naturally unpainted lips, gentle closed smile, normal bare ears, skin tone and adult body proportions. No makeup, jewelry or watch. Maintain thin clean anime outlines and restrained soft cel rendering across face AND whole body.
The user wants a polished outfit plausible for a contemporary business-casual workday, with understated exposure at collarbones/upper chest, bare arms or forearms, and legs below a knee-length skirt. Use naturally fitted tailoring with sensible ease at bust, waist and hips, opaque practical fabrics and functional seams. The effect should be attractive but still a recognizably tidy everyday office look. Modest open collars, restrained V/scoop/boat/square necklines and short or sleeveless tops are appropriate. All breasts and pelvis remain fully covered.
No plunging neckline, exposed lower bust, off-shoulder party cut, crop top, bare midriff, transparent torso, mini skirt, high thigh slit, strained shirt buttons, lingerie or evening gown. Keep skirts at or just around the knee, sensible walking vents and low-to-medium practical heels. No bag, phone, lanyard, props, logos, text, panels or watermark.
Keep original head position/scale, level shoulders, upright FRONT full-body neutral stance, arms relaxed at sides and both hands visible with a thumb plus four coherent fingers and clean nails. Same adult stature and proportions, 1024x1536 centered portrait, complete head through closed-toe shoes, safe margins. TRUE transparent alpha background, no floor, painted backdrop, aura or glow. Replace all old plum dress/buttons/shoes. One complete sprite only.
Workday outfit 01: Opaque ivory short-sleeve blouse with a restrained V neckline exposing collarbones and a small amount of upper chest while completely covering bust, softly regular-fit tailoring, tucked into a navy high-waist knee-length H-line skirt. Small side walking vent beginning only near the knee, thin navy belt, navy low-heel closed-toe pumps.
